suite_name: WPT SVG Mix-Blend-Mode, Compositing, and Filter Reftests
description: Comprehensive self-contained SVG test and reference pairs extracted from Web Platform Tests and resvg-test-suite covering mix-blend-mode, feBlend (all 16 blend modes), subregions, gradients, nested clip paths, multi-stage filter chains, zero-area path fills (PR #360), Gaussian blur kernels (Issue #325), and non-default color spaces (linearRGB vs sRGB) for FemtoVG.

tests.description: Blended element having mix-blend-mode: multiply and rounded clip-path blends with parent aqua backdrop, producing lime inside clip while preserving aqua outside.
Parent has asymmetrical rounded clip (rx=16, ry=80) and red backdrop. Oversized child (200x200 yellow) blends with difference, producing lime strictly within parent clip without bleed.
Tests backdrop evaluation across clipped sibling boundaries. Blended sibling overlaps both a clipped rounded sibling and the parent container backdrop.
Blended element under rotated clip path. Red rect rotated -45 deg with overlay blend mode over lime yields lime; tests transformed clip stencil mapping in offscreen blend resolve.
Parent circular shape without overflow clipping. Child yellow square blends with red circle to produce green circle, while non-overlapping yellow child does not blend with gray canvas.
Order of operations: filter (feColorMatrix grayscale) applies to element before mix-blend-mode: screen blends with backdrop.
Presence of a filter does not isolate the element from its backdrop or disrupt the blend pass; red difference over yellow yields lime.
Chained filter primitives evaluated sequentially preserve color values and alpha channels without loss or degradation.
Mask restricts where blended element is visible; red difference over yellow produces green circle, while backdrop outside mask remains intact.
Filter applies before mask on SVG elements; blurred red square is clipped by mask to 100x100, preventing red blur fringe leakage.
Filter applies before clip-path on SVG elements; blurred red square is clipped to 100x100, preventing red blur fringe leakage.
Group with isolation: isolate prevents inner element with difference blend mode from blending with outer green backdrop; solid green passes.
Group with opacity < 1 creates isolated stacking context; inner lighten blend mode does not lighten against outer blue backdrop.
Isolated group (lime) with multiply child (red); intersection is black, but child overflowing the group bounds does not blend with container yellow.
Isolated group with oversized blended child; perimeter outside group bounds blends with group's transparent backdrop, resulting in aqua border (red indicates isolation leak to canvas).
Two green squares with black intersection over lightgray canvas; overflowing blender child does not blend with lightgray canvas.
Children inside a blended group composite together into group buffer before blending with backdrop; red child covering dark base blends with yellow to yield lime.
Blur filter effect on elements is strictly clipped by ancestor clipPath; zero blue blur fringes escape from behind covering green rect.
Clips applied to descendants of a filter group are evaluated in the descendant local coordinate space before blur is executed.
Source element outside ancestor clip is clipped away, but its drop-shadow cast back into the clip bounds remains visible.
Tests plus-lighter additive blending on overlapping semi-transparent SVG rects within an isolated group.
SVG root document establishes an isolated transparent backdrop; green difference with transparent black yields pure green.
Element-to-element SVG blending using multiply; aqua rect overlapped by red rect produces solid black square.
Filling an SVG <line> element produces zero inked pixels across horizontal, vertical, diagonal, and rotated lines under explicit or default fill.
An open path without closepath whose points lie on one line encloses zero area and produces zero inked pixels.
Closed degenerate polygon with collinear vertices (M...L...Z) encloses zero area and produces zero inked pixels.
Path that steps outward and retraces backward along the identical line has zero enclosed area and produces zero inked pixels.
Cubic and quadratic Bézier curves whose control points lie entirely on the line segment between endpoints enclose zero area and draw nothing.
A valid non-zero area polygon (50x50 square) attached to a 1000-unit collinear tail fills the square normally while the tail produces zero pixels.
Collinear points with non-integer floating-point coordinates evaluate to zero area without precision leakage and produce zero inked pixels.
Contrast control: a narrow sliver with positive non-zero area (height=1px, base=160px) is not collinear and must fill with anti-aliasing.
stdDeviation with 0 on one axis blurs strictly along the non-zero axis without blurring the perpendicular axis or dividing by zero.
Zero or negative stdDeviation disables blur and acts as an exact identity pass (sharp edges, no blur halo).
Default edgeMode='none' samples transparent black outside element bounds; blurred rect fades smoothly to alpha=0 over 3*sigma without edge clamping bands.
Filter effects applied to an element itself expand its visual overflow bounds; element bounding box does not clip its own filter halo.
Explicit filter primitive subregion (x, y, width, height) strictly clips the blurred output to the defined subregion rectangle.
Successive Gaussian convolutions compound in quadrature: chained blurs with sigma=3 and sigma=4 match a single blur of sigma=5.0.
Blur under color-interpolation-filters='sRGB' operates in non-linear sRGB space, matching CSS blur() shorthand.
